consequence.statement: Dual-stack support is now available at Alpha maturity level for testing and evaluation.

original.statement: Istio dual-stack support has been promoted to Alpha maturity status in release 1.24.0.

decision.reason: [ev-f3c3e6abdb99] only says Istio dual-stack support was promoted to Alpha. That is a maturity-label change: nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, so a failure kind would over-claim. The evidence also states no new default that would apply without operator action, so behavior-change is not supported. 'none' (informational) fits. Confidence is low because the note doesn't say whether the feature is opt-in.
